display_name: Superior Attuned Superior Stalkers Guile F
help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character.  Gives the Stalker a chance to enter a hidden state when they strike their target with the slotted power and reduces recharge time by {Boost.Attrib.Recharge.Scale}%.  This effect will trigger roughly 5 times per minute.  This enhancement can only be slotted by Stalkers and can be slotted into nearly all Stalker damage powers.
power_display_names: Superior Stalker's Guile: Recharge/Chance to Hide
power_short_helps: Increases Attack Rate and Chance to Hide
